bio.text: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins is a Democratic candidate for governor of Alaska in 2026.
A Democrat from Sitka, he served in the Alaska House of Representatives from 2013 to 2023.
He was born and raised in Sitka.
While in the Legislature he was a member of the bipartisan fiscal working group that drafted a long-term fiscal plan in 2021.
